card.name: Start of boxed warning and copyright text
card.fires_on: The word USE in the opening boxed warning heading "SERIOUS AND LIFE-THREATENING RISKS FROM USE OF" before an opioid name. It also fires at the break after a copyright line or a sentence ending in web-page text.

modes.label: Boxed warning heading
modes.description: The word USE in the heading "RISKS FROM USE OF" before an opioid drug name.
modes.example: WARNING: SERIOUS AND LIFE-THREATENING RISKS FROM<< USE>> OF TRAMADOL HYDRO

modes.label: Copyright or publication text
modes.description: The gap or sentence end after copyright or series notices on general web pages.
